def: An open-source reinforcement-learning library for LLM post-training, started by ByteDance's Seed team, that implements the HybridFlow design (Sheng et al., 2024).
practice: It supports PPO, GRPO, DAPO and other algorithms, generates rollouts with vLLM or SGLang, trains with FSDP or Megatron-LM, and handles multi-turn tool-calling rollouts.
